title: Classic gateway can't reach the source; serverless on the same connection can

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27 in a container, classic gateway and a serverless probe

symptom: The extractor started, then FAILED with INGESTION_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR.INCORRECT_SOURCE_HOSTNAME_OR_PORT_SPECIFIED_FAILURE ("Could not connect to the source database"). A serverless probe on the same connection connected.
cause: The source's firewall had no rule for the classic compute's egress address.
effect: A classic gateway can't read the source.
fix: Allow the classic egress address (lfc-source-firewall, classic-egress.md), then rerun.
notes: The rerun with the rule added isn't recorded yet.
